h1: Custom 40 oz Backpacks for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom 40 oz backpacks in bulk. Ideal for corporate gifts and events. Get a quote today from Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: When you need a lightweight, compact backpack for giveaways or corporate swag, a 40 oz capacity hits the sweet spot. These backpacks are large enough to hold a tablet, lunch, and a jacket, but small enough to pack easily. Perfect for day trips or commutes, they offer a practical canvas for your logo using screen printing or embroidery. Choose from multiple colors to match your brand.
